value.rationale: The two explicit normal isolated counterexamples to Nash nontermination motivate asking whether their birational discrepancies are severe and whether crepant alternatives exist. The characteristic-two source is terminal and nevertheless the Nash procedure fails; it has no projective crepant resolution even beyond toric geometry. The order-eleven source uniquely extracts one crepant divisor but leaves exactly three unavoidable terminal toric quotient points. This complete comparative birational profile is a motivated structural boundary for prominent new examples, not a numerical adjustment or arbitrary isolated type test.
